The vector dT>ds points in the direction in which T turns as the curve bends. There- fore, if we face in the direction of increasing arc length, the vector dT>ds points toward the right if T turns clockwise and toward the left if T turns counterclockwise. In other words, the principal normal vector N will point toward the concave side of the curve (Figure 13.19).
